Question: For some positive integers \(p,\) there is a quadrilateral \(ABCD\) with positive integer side lengths, perimeter \(p,\) right angles at \(B\) and \(C,\) \(AB = 2,\) and \(CD = AD.\) How many different values of \(p \lt 2015\) are possible?
